turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale, or Mr. Hale, whichever it is. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
I didn't come to be thanked. I came for an answer, and I'm still waiting for it.
We're not finished, Hale. My son has a zero in your gradebook, and you still haven't told me on what basis.
Say it however you like, Hale, I'm not leaving. I have until 4:40, and you still owe me an answer on that zero.
